storage.built_in: 16, 24, 32, 48 or 64 TB effective by model (24 to 80 TB raw), RAID 6; OS on 2 x 480 GB M.2 SSD, RAID 1

power.supply: 100 to 240 VAC, 50/60 Hz, auto-switching; single 1400 W, optional redundant power supply available

features: 2 x 10 GbE SFP+ ports optional with the 10 GbE kit (NVR6-AINVR2-FORM-D-10GBE)
Analytic channels: up to 90 Appearance Search, 50 Facial Recognition + Appearance Search
Windows Server 2022 LTSC or Windows 10 IoT Enterprise LTSC 2021
notes: Up to 130 channels at 900 Mbps requires the optional 10 GbE kit (NVR6-AINVR2-FORM-D-10GBE); on a single non-teamed 1 GbE connection the datasheet gives up to 120 channels at 800 Mbps.
Outgoing bandwidth is the stated livestream rate.
